before.title: About FermatMind
before.summary: Who we are, what we build, and the standards behind our assessment product.
before.content_md:
## Our mission

FermatMind builds practical assessment tools for personality insight, growth planning, and role-fit reflection.

We focus on clear interpretation language that can be applied in real decisions, not abstract labels.

## Assessment approach

- Structured questionnaires with transparent scoring logic

- Readable reports focused on behavior and decision implications

- Iterative quality review across item wording and flow completion

## Privacy and safety boundary

FermatMind reports are designed for education and self-reflection. They are not medical diagnosis and do not replace professional care.

We avoid absolute claims and continuously align product practice with applicable privacy principles.

source_snapshot.title: 关于 FermatMind
source_snapshot.summary: 我们是谁、做什么，以及测评产品背后的方法边界。
source_snapshot.content_md:
## 我们的目标

FermatMind 聚焦人格洞察、成长规划与角色匹配，提供可执行的测评工具。

我们强调可读、可用、可落地的解释语言，而不仅是标签化结论。

## 测评方法

- 结构化问卷与透明评分逻辑

- 结果解释聚焦行为表现与决策影响

- 持续优化题项表达与流程完成率

## 隐私与安全边界

FermatMind 报告用于教育和自我认知，不是医疗诊断，也不替代专业治疗建议。

我们避免绝对化承诺，并按适用情形持续对齐隐私保护原则。
source_snapshot.meta_description: 我们是谁、做什么，以及测评产品背后的方法边界。

snapshot.title: About FermatMind
snapshot.summary: Who we are, what we do, and the methodological boundaries behind our assessment products.
snapshot.content_md:
## Our goals

FermatMind focuses on personality insight, growth planning, and role matching, providing practical assessment tools.

We emphasize interpretation that is readable, usable, and actionable, rather than conclusions that simply assign labels.

## Assessment methods

- Structured questionnaires and transparent scoring logic

- Result interpretation focused on behavior and its implications for decisions

- Continuous improvements to item wording and flow completion rates

## Privacy and safety boundaries

FermatMind reports are for education and self-understanding. They are not medical diagnoses and do not replace professional treatment advice.

We avoid absolute promises and continue to align with privacy protection principles as applicable.
snapshot.meta_description: Who we are, what we do, and the methodological boundaries behind our assessment products.

before.title: Our Team
before.summary: A cross-functional team covering psychometrics, product, engineering, and content quality.
before.content_md:
## Core functions

- Psychometrics and content: framework design, item quality, interpretation tone

- Product and UX: completion flow, clarity, and usability validation

- Engineering and data: reliability, privacy controls, and secure delivery

- Support and operations: policy handling, issue triage, and response workflow

## How we work

We ship in small, testable iterations and prioritize measurable clarity improvements.

When user risk is involved, we choose conservative language and explicit boundaries.

source_snapshot.title: 团队介绍
source_snapshot.summary: 由心理测量、产品、工程与内容质量共同协作的跨职能团队。
source_snapshot.content_md:
## 核心分工

- 心理测量与内容：框架设计、题项质量、解释口径

- 产品与体验：流程设计、可理解性与可用性验证

- 工程与数据：稳定性、隐私控制与安全交付

- 支持与运营：政策处理、问题分级与反馈闭环

## 协作方式

我们以小步可验证方式持续迭代，优先解决影响用户决策质量的问题。

涉及风险的场景采用更保守表达与更明确的使用边界。
source_snapshot.meta_description: 由心理测量、产品、工程与内容质量共同协作的跨职能团队。

snapshot.title: Our Team
snapshot.summary: A cross-functional team collaborating across psychometrics, product, engineering, and content quality.
snapshot.content_md:
## Core responsibilities

- Psychometrics and content: framework design, item quality, and consistent interpretation

- Product and experience: flow design, clarity, and usability validation

- Engineering and data: stability, privacy controls, and secure delivery

- Support and operations: policy handling, issue triage, and a complete feedback loop

## How we collaborate

We continue to iterate in small, verifiable steps, prioritizing problems that affect the quality of users' decisions.

In situations involving risk, we use more conservative wording and clearer boundaries on use.

before.title: Payment and refund help
before.summary: FermatMind provides free tests and selected free result views. Some advanced report modules may require paid unlock. If you paid but cannot access the full report, you may contact support within 7 days for refund review; refund processing time is 3 business days.
before.content_md:
FermatMind tests can be started for free. Some tests provide a free basic result view, while selected advanced report modules may require paid unlock.

Before payment, users should be able to see:

- which test or report the unlock applies to;
- the price and currency;
- what the unlocked report is expected to include;
- where to get support if payment or unlock fails;
- the refund window and eligibility conditions.

If you paid but cannot access the full report, contact support by email within 7 days. We will review the case using your purchase email, test name, approximate payment time, and issue description.

Refund review applies when we confirm that you cannot access the full report you purchased. Refunds do not apply to issues not caused by FermatMind. Refund processing time is 3 business days.

Do not post full order numbers, unmasked payment details, full result links, or history links on public pages, social platforms, or screenshots.

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:start -->

### What is free?

You can start the tests for free, and selected basic result views may also be free. Some advanced report modules may require paid unlock.

### When can I request a refund?

If you paid but cannot access the full report, you may contact support within 7 days for refund review.

### Can I get a refund after viewing the full report?

If the full report was delivered normally, refund review usually does not apply to subjective dissatisfaction alone. Support will review any exceptional case.

### What information is needed for a refund request?

Provide the purchase email, test name, approximate payment time, and a short issue description. Public Help pages do not require a full order number.

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:end -->

source_snapshot.title: 支付与退款说明
source_snapshot.summary: 费马测试的基础测评和部分结果可以免费使用。部分高阶报告模块可能需要付费解锁。若你付款后无法获得完整报告，并且在 7 天内联系支持邮箱，可以申请退款处理；退款处理时限为三个工作日。
source_snapshot.content_md:
费马测试的基础测评可以免费开始。部分测试会提供免费的基础结果；某些高阶报告模块可能需要付费解锁。

在付款前，你应该能清楚看到：

- 当前解锁对应的测试或报告；
- 价格和币种；
- 解锁后预计可以查看的内容范围；
- 支付失败或未解锁时的支持路径；
- 退款条件和申请窗口。

如果你已经付款，但无法获得完整报告，可以在付款后 7 天内通过支持邮箱联系我们。我们会根据购买邮箱、测试名称、付款时间和问题描述进行核查。

退款适用于确认无法获得完整报告的情况。退款不适用于非“费马测试”原因导致的问题。退款处理时限为三个工作日。

请不要在公开页面、社交平台或截图中展示完整订单编号、支付流水号、完整结果链接或历史页面链接。

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:start -->

### 哪些内容是免费的？

基础测评可以免费开始，部分基础结果也可以免费查看。某些高阶报告模块可能需要单独付费解锁。

### 什么情况下可以申请退款？

如果你付款后无法获得完整报告，并且在付款后 7 天内联系支持邮箱，可以申请退款处理。

### 如果我已经看到了完整报告，还可以退款吗？

如果完整报告已经正常交付，退款通常不适用于单纯主观不满意的情况。具体情况仍需由支持团队审核。

### 申请退款需要提供什么？

请提供购买邮箱、测试名称、付款的大致时间和问题描述。公开页面不要求提供完整订单编号。

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:end -->

snapshot.title: Payment and Refund Information
snapshot.summary: FermatMind basic assessments and some results are free to use. Some advanced report modules may require paid access. If you cannot obtain the full report after payment and contact the support email within 7 days, you can request refund processing; refunds are processed within three business days.
snapshot.content_md:
FermatMind basic assessments can be started for free. Some tests provide free basic results; certain advanced report modules may require paid access.

Before payment, you should be able to clearly see:

- the test or report covered by the current unlock;
- the price and currency;
- the scope of content you can expect to view after unlocking;
- the support path if payment fails or the report does not unlock;
- the refund conditions and request window.

If you have paid but cannot obtain the full report, you can contact us through the support email within 7 days after payment. We will investigate using your purchase email, test name, payment time, and issue description.

Refunds apply when it is confirmed that you cannot obtain the full report. Refunds do not apply to problems that are not caused by FermatMind. Refunds are processed within three business days.

Do not display full order numbers, payment transaction numbers, full result links, or history page links on public pages, social platforms, or in screenshots.

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:start -->

### What content is free?

Basic assessments can be started for free, and some basic results are also free to view. Certain advanced report modules may require a separate payment to unlock.

### When can I request a refund?

If you cannot obtain the full report after payment and contact the support email within 7 days after payment, you can request refund processing.

### Can I still get a refund if I have already viewed the full report?

If the full report has been delivered normally, refunds generally do not apply to subjective dissatisfaction alone. The support team still needs to review the specific circumstances.

### What do I need to provide to request a refund?

Provide your purchase email, test name, approximate payment time, and issue description. Public pages do not require a full order number.

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:end -->

before.title: What to do if your report does not unlock after payment
before.summary: If you completed payment but the full report did not unlock, do not pay again immediately. Contact support with your purchase email, test name, language, approximate payment time, and a short description of the issue. We will review unlock issues within 24 hours.
before.content_md:
If you have paid but cannot see the full report, please do not pay again immediately.

An unlock issue may happen if the payment page was closed early, the browser did not refresh after returning from the payment provider, the network was interrupted, the payment callback was delayed, or you are trying to view the report on another device.

Please contact support by email. To help us locate the issue, include:

- the email used for purchase;
- the test name, such as MBTI, Holland / RIASEC, or Big Five;
- the language version;
- the approximate payment time;
- a short description of what happened.

You may optionally include the last 6 characters of your order code or a masked order code. Do not post a full order number, unmasked payment details, full result link, or history link in public comments, social platforms, screenshots, or non-private pages.

We will review unlock issues within 24 hours. If we confirm that you cannot access the full report you purchased, the case will move into the refund process.

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:start -->

### Should I pay again if the report does not unlock?

No. Contact support first with your purchase email, test name, language version, approximate payment time, and a short issue description.

### Do I need to provide the full order number?

Public Help pages do not require a full order number. Support usually starts from your purchase email and may use the last 6 characters of a masked order code if needed.

### How long does unlock support take?

Unlock issues are reviewed within 24 hours, or we will provide the next step.

### Can I get a refund if I still cannot access the report?

If we confirm that you cannot access the full report and the request is within the 7-day refund window, the case can enter the refund process.

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:end -->

source_snapshot.summary: 如果你已经完成付款，但完整报告没有正常解锁，请先不要重复付款。你可以通过支持邮箱提交购买邮箱、测试名称、语言版本、付款的大致时间和问题描述。我们会在 24 小时内处理解锁异常或给出下一步说明。
source_snapshot.content_md:
如果你已经付款，但没有看到完整报告，请先不要重复付款。

报告没有解锁通常可能发生在这些场景中：支付页面关闭过早、浏览器返回导致状态没有刷新、网络中断、支付渠道回调延迟，或你正在不同设备上查看结果。

请通过支持邮箱联系我们。为了帮助我们定位问题，请提供以下信息：

- 购买时使用的邮箱；
- 测试名称，例如 MBTI、霍兰德 / RIASEC 或大五人格；
- 页面语言版本；
- 付款的大致时间；
- 问题描述，例如“付款后仍显示未解锁”。

如果你愿意，也可以提供订单编号的后 6 位或脱敏订单码。请不要在公开评论、社交平台、截图说明或非私密页面中发送完整订单编号、支付流水号、完整结果链接或历史页面链接。

我们会在 24 小时内检查解锁状态。若确认你无法获得已购买的完整报告，将按退款政策进入处理流程。

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:start -->

### 付款后报告没有解锁，我应该重新付款吗？

不建议立即重复付款。请先联系支持邮箱，并提供购买邮箱、测试名称、语言版本、付款的大致时间和问题描述。

### 我需要提供完整订单编号吗？

公开帮助页面不要求你提供完整订单编号。支持邮箱排查时，一般优先使用购买邮箱，也可以使用订单编号后 6 位或脱敏订单码辅助定位。

### 多久会处理解锁失败？

解锁异常会在 24 小时内处理或给出下一步说明。

### 如果最后仍无法获得完整报告，可以退款吗？

如果确认你无法获得完整报告，并且符合 7 天退款条件，可以进入退款处理流程。

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:end -->

snapshot.title: What Should I Do If My Report Does Not Unlock After Payment?
snapshot.summary: If you have completed payment but the full report has not unlocked normally, please do not pay again yet. You can send your purchase email, test name, language version, approximate payment time, and issue description to the support email. We will address the unlock issue or explain the next step within 24 hours.
snapshot.content_md:
If you have paid but cannot see the full report, please do not pay again yet.

A report may fail to unlock if the payment page was closed too early, returning in the browser did not refresh the status, the network was interrupted, the payment channel callback was delayed, or you are viewing the result on another device.

Contact us through the support email. To help us locate the issue, provide the following information:

- the email used for purchase;
- the test name, such as MBTI, Holland / RIASEC, or Big Five;
- the page language version;
- the approximate payment time;
- an issue description, such as “still shown as locked after payment”.

If you wish, you can also provide the last 6 digits of the order number or a masked order code. Do not send full order numbers, payment transaction numbers, full result links, or history page links in public comments, on social platforms, in screenshot descriptions, or on non-private pages.

We will check the unlock status within 24 hours. If we confirm that you cannot obtain the full report you purchased, we will begin processing the case under the refund policy.

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:start -->

### Should I pay again if the report has not unlocked after payment?

We do not recommend paying again immediately. Contact the support email first and provide your purchase email, test name, language version, approximate payment time, and issue description.

### Do I need to provide the full order number?

Public help pages do not require your full order number. When investigating through the support email, we generally start with your purchase email. The last 6 digits of the order number or a masked order code can also help locate the issue.

### How long does it take to handle an unlock failure?

Unlock issues will be addressed or the next step explained within 24 hours.

### Can I get a refund if I still cannot obtain the full report?

If it is confirmed that you cannot obtain the full report and you meet the 7-day refund conditions, the case can enter the refund process.

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:end -->

before.title: How to recover your test result
before.summary: FermatMind result records are retained for 2 years by default. You can contact support using the email associated with your test or purchase to recover a result. Do not post full result links, history links, or private URLs from screenshots on public pages or social platforms.
before.content_md:
If you closed the result page, changed devices, or want to view your result later, you can contact support by email to request recovery.

FermatMind result records are retained for 2 years by default. Recovery usually starts from the email associated with the test or purchase. You may also include the test name, language version, and approximate completion time.

If no email was provided, or if there is not enough information to verify ownership, we may not be able to locate or recover the result.

Do not post full result links, history links, or private URLs from screenshots on public pages, social platforms, or comment areas. Result links are generally intended for personal access, not public sharing.

If you request data deletion and the deletion is completed, the corresponding result may no longer be recoverable.

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:start -->

### How long are results retained?

Result records are retained for 2 years by default, unless you request deletion or a later reviewed policy states otherwise.

### How can I recover a result?

Contact support by email with the email associated with your test or purchase, the test name, language version, and approximate completion time.

### Can I recover a result without an email?

If no email or sufficient information is available, we may not be able to verify ownership or recover the result.

### Can I publicly share my result link?

No. Do not publicly share full result or history links, because they may contain information intended only for personal access.

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:end -->

source_snapshot.title: 如何找回测试结果？
source_snapshot.summary: 费马测试的结果记录默认保存 2 年。你可以使用购买或测试时关联的邮箱联系支持团队找回结果。请不要在公开页面或社交平台发布完整结果链接、历史链接或截图中的私密地址。
source_snapshot.content_md:
如果你关闭了结果页、换了设备，或稍后想重新查看测试结果，可以通过邮箱联系支持团队申请找回。

费马测试的结果记录默认保存 2 年。找回时，我们通常会优先使用你测试或购买时关联的邮箱来定位记录。为了提高处理效率，你也可以提供测试名称、语言版本和大致完成时间。

如果你没有留下邮箱，或者无法提供足够信息，我们可能无法确认结果归属，也可能无法找回对应记录。

请不要在公开页面、社交平台、评论区或未遮挡截图中发布完整结果链接、历史页面链接或带有私密参数的地址。结果链接通常只适合你本人查看，不应作为公开分享链接使用。

如果你申请删除数据，删除完成后，对应结果可能无法再恢复。

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:start -->

### 测试结果会保存多久？

结果记录默认保存 2 年，除非你申请删除相关数据或后续政策另有说明。

### 如何找回结果？

请通过支持邮箱联系我们，并提供测试或购买时关联的邮箱、测试名称、语言版本和大致完成时间。

### 没有邮箱还能找回吗？

如果没有邮箱或足够信息，我们可能无法确认结果归属，也可能无法找回对应记录。

### 我可以公开分享结果链接吗？

不建议公开分享完整结果链接或历史链接。它们可能包含只适合你本人访问的信息。

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:end -->

snapshot.title: How Can I Recover My Test Result?
snapshot.summary: FermatMind result records are retained for 2 years by default. You can contact the support team using the email associated with your purchase or test to recover your result. Do not post full result links, history links, or private addresses from screenshots on public pages or social platforms.
snapshot.content_md:
If you closed the result page, changed devices, or want to view your test result again later, you can contact the support team by email to request recovery.

FermatMind result records are retained for 2 years by default. When recovering a result, we usually start with the email associated with your test or purchase to locate the record. To help us process the request more efficiently, you can also provide the test name, language version, and approximate completion time.

If you did not provide an email or cannot provide enough information, we may be unable to confirm who the result belongs to or recover the corresponding record.

Do not publish full result links, history page links, or addresses containing private parameters on public pages, social platforms, in comments, or in unmasked screenshots. Result links are generally only suitable for your own access and should not be used as public sharing links.

If you request data deletion, the corresponding result may no longer be recoverable once deletion is complete.

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:start -->

### How long are test results retained?

Result records are retained for 2 years by default, unless you request deletion of the relevant data or a later policy states otherwise.

### How can I recover my result?

Contact us through the support email and provide the email associated with your test or purchase, the test name, language version, and approximate completion time.

### Can I recover a result without an email?

Without an email or enough information, we may be unable to confirm who the result belongs to or recover the corresponding record.

### Can I publicly share my result link?

We do not recommend publicly sharing full result links or history links. They may contain information intended only for your own access.

<!-- help-service-visible-faq:end -->
